Class CsvPersistenceService

java.lang.Object
com.exchange.persistence.CsvPersistenceService
All Implemented Interfaces:
PersistenceService
public class CsvPersistenceService extends Object implements PersistenceService
File-based CSV implementation of PersistenceService providing human-readable, zero-dependency storage for trading accounts, holdings, and transaction ledgers.
Since:
1.0
